section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines the research hypotheses for a study validating the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) in Black college women and examining the role of ethnic identity in body appreciation. The study involves one sample of Black undergraduate/college women and tests multiple hypotheses regarding relationships between body appreciation, appearance satisfaction, self-esteem, beauty ideal internalization, eating behaviors, ethnic identity, and eating disorder symptoms.
